sentences.en: They are dancing, intoxicated with the beauty of cherry blossoms.
sentences.zh: 他们正在跳舞，沉醉于樱花盛开的美丽之中。

sentences.en: The cherry blossom season brings crowds of people to parks.
sentences.zh: 赏樱季节吸引了大批人群来到公园。

sentences.en: We got to Washington in time for the cherry blossoms.
sentences.zh: 我们及时赶到华盛顿，正好赶上樱花盛开。

senses.zh: 花；开花期；兴旺期；花开的状态
